description: perdure plugin hooks. PreCompact auto-archives the session before /compact, gated by ~/.claude/perdure-preferences.json (auto-archive-before-compact, default off). PostToolUse runs the record-rot lint when an Edit/Write lands on a perdure/workflows/*.md record whose status is terminal or near-terminal (closed/done/finished earn a vocabulary correction), regenerates a stale generator-stamped perdure/HANDOFF.md host-side after such an edit (never creates one, never overwrites a hand-written page; opt-out via handoff-regen-at-close, default on), and warns on direct edits to that derived page — advisory, silent when clean, opt-out via rot-lint-at-close (default on).
